decision: The original fast FIFO GX helper remains disabled: a GX-only comparison, with integer FIFO and short-prefix both off, still changes scheduler insertion orders. The separate full FIFO-check source candidate must also be repeated GX-only before its repair hypothesis can be evaluated.
limits: Matching sampled fighter/controller fingerprints does not authorize ignoring serialized event orders or guarantee deterministic future timing. This replay has no 30-second FPS gain to attribute to the source change.
